verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes an extensible site architecture that can integrate additional franchise locations using a consistent location template.
The client specifies reusable website structure with location-specific branding and wording, concretely refining the location-template behavior.
The client adds the architectural acceptance condition that future locations must be addable without redesigning the site and confirms consistent location-page structure and branding.
The client designates the Ridgehaven page as the reusable implementation template for future location websites.
